description.it: Gli utenti con più prestiti nel periodo. Riservato agli amministratori.
description.en: The patrons with the most loans in the period. Administrators only.

sql: SELECT p.last_name || ' ' || p.first_name AS patron, pc.class_label AS class, COUNT(*) AS loans FROM loan l JOIN patron p ON p.id = l.patron_id LEFT JOIN patron_class pc ON pc.patron_id = p.id WHERE date(l.issued_at) BETWEEN :from AND :to AND p.status = 'active' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY loans DESC, patron LIMIT :top
